meta.name: abp-object-mapping
meta.description: ABP Framework v10.x (10.4/10.5) object mapping: IObjectMapper, Mapperly (default since v10.4, MapperBase), AutoMapper profiles, entity↔DTO conversion, AutoMap attributes. Use when you need object mapping or DTO mapping in ABP.

copy.tagline: 简化 ABP 框架中的对象映射与 DTO 转换
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在使用 ABP 框架时需要实体与 DTO 的映射转换
copy.tagline_en: Simplify object mapping and DTO conversion in ABP framework
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need entity-to-DTO mapping in ABP framework

howto.what: 装上此技能后，Claude 能够帮助你在 ABP Framework v10.x 中处理对象映射，包括实体与 DTO 之间的转换。它会提供使用 IObjectMapper 抽象、Mapperly（v10.4 起默认）或 AutoMapper 的代码示例及配置方法。
howto.when: 当用户提到“ABP object mapping”、“ABP entity to DTO mapping”或“ABP DTO mapping”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 Mapperly 创建 Book 到 BookDto 的映射。
如何在 ABP 中使用 AutoMapper 定义 profile？
say.note: Claude 会提供 Profile 类和模块配置代码。

say.text: 使用 IObjectMapper 将列表映射为 DTO 列表。

howto.what_en: After installing this skill, Claude can help you with object mapping in ABP Framework v10.x, including conversion between entities and DTOs. It provides code examples for using IObjectMapper, Mapperly (default since v10.4), or AutoMapper, and guides on configuration.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions keywords like 'ABP object mapping', 'ABP entity to DTO mapping', or 'ABP DTO mapping'.

say_en.text: Help me create a Book to BookDto mapping using Mapperly.
say_en.note: Claude will generate MapperBase derived class and module configuration.

say_en.text: How to define an AutoMapper profile in ABP?
say_en.note: Claude will provide Profile class and module configuration code.

say_en.text: Map a list to DTO list using IObjectMapper.
say_en.note: Claude will demonstrate Map<List<Book>, List<BookDto>> usage.
